jobs.title: Town Planning Graduate Programme
jobs.description:
Build a brilliant career. Shape a sustainable tomorrow.

Do you want to build your career with a globally connected, welcoming team? Where you'll be trusted with real responsibility, empowered to contribute to projects that create a more sustainable future - and given the support to develop both professionally and personally?

Take the driver's seat in your career on the AtkinsRéalis Graduate Development Programme, guided by inspiring, supportive managers. And say yes to brilliant opportunities that spark your interest, knowing you'll have training and the support you need to maintain a healthy work‑life balance.

We believe reaching your full potential means being able to bring your whole self to work and feeling like you belong. Find out more about our global programme Different Makes a Difference.

We are AtkinsRéalis, a world‑class engineering services and nuclear organization. Here you’ll help create world‑class sustainable solutions that connect people, data and technology. We're transforming infrastructure and energy systems, growing partnerships with our clients, and bringing the most complex projects across the globe to life.

Our global team of 40,000+ employees speak over 70 languages and represent some 130 nationalities across six continents. Our work covers a variety of sectors, including power, transportation, infrastructure, environment, water, nuclear, technology, defence and aerospace.

Where you could work

You'll have the opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects, develop new skills and gain valuable experience while making a positive impact on people, communities and the environment.

Depending on your interests and location preferences, you could join one of our teams working within the Buildings and Places sector, helping to deliver some of the world's most complex and rewarding projects.

Want to learn more? Follow the link above to explore the sector, the teams and types of projects you could work on.

What you can bring

A curious mindset and enthusiasm for solving real-world challenges
A desire to champion a culture where everyone belongs
A collaborative working style and confidence building positive relationships
Enthusiasm and drive to develop your skillset and seek out development opportunities within a supportive team
Motivation to achieve professional accreditation (where applicable)
Comfortable embracing agile ways of working and learning new technologies
A commitment to spend a minimum of three days a week in the office or on client site (project dependent). Being together in person helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more effectively, and accelerate your learning and development.

How do I apply?

Click " Apply
" to start your application - you'll be taken to our vacancies platform, where you can explore specific graduate roles that match your interests. On the platform use the search and filter options to narrow down roles by location, sector and other preferences, select the role you'd like to apply for and submit your application.

Please note - you can only make one application
per recruitment campaign.

For tips and advice on applying - and to message your questions directly to one of our graduate mentors - check out our Early Careers TalentConnector platform.

As a Disability Confident Employer we can make adjustments to support you to perform at your best during the recruitment process. To find out how we can support you please contact us confidentially at graduates@atkinsrealis.com

Our deadline for applications is 3 December 2026. However, as our Graduate Development Programmes are incredibly popular, apply early as some roles may close sooner.

More about us

AtkinsRéalis is a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We design and deliver major projects on the built and natural environments all around the world. We believe that digitally enabled engineering has the power to radically improve the way we are all housed, connected, powered, and protected and can change our relationship with our communities and our planet for the better. We are committed to building a culture where everyone belongs - a place where you can all be yourself, thrive and reach your full potential. Join us and engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Learn more

Training and development

Our Graduate Development Programme is designed to give you an insight into many areas of work and the chance to explore where your own skills and interests lie. It features a series of training events and modules, professional development, mentoring, and on-the-job experience as well as practical skills development.

From day one, you'll work on real projects that offer scale and variety, collaborating with colleagues and creating meaningful impact on the world around us. You'll work towards your professional accreditation (where applicable) - whichever path you take, your future starts here.

Meeting your needs

We’ll reward and support you in many ways, including offering:

a settling-in payment of £2,500 when you join and a further payment of £2,500 when you achieve chartered status or reach an equivalent stage in your professional development
33 days’ annual leave, including bank holidays, with the option to buy an additional 15 days or sell up to 5 days
two paid annual volunteer days
a brilliant range of rewards and benefits
opportunities to join talented graduates in skill-building, social events, charity challenges, Young Professional Awards, social clubs and exciting secondments
access to employee networks for social interaction, peer support and personal development
opportunities to develop yourself by applying to various company-wide development programmes
access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), providing you with immediate and confidential help for any work, health or life matters and a wealth of other wellbeing resources
an enhanced maternity scheme and family-friendly policies.

Our graduate salaries are between £32,000 - £34,500 depending on role and location.

Additional information

This role may require a security clearance, and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at the interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role, please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application details of any current or previously held security clearance.

Due to current Government immigration salary thresholds, AtkinsRéalis do not sponsor any skilled worker visas for our early careers programme as the Home Office's eligibility criteria would not be met. Given the length of our early careers programme AtkinsRéalis requires applicants to have the right to work in the UK (without sponsorship by AtkinsRéalis) for the duration of the programme. Applicants should ensure they can meet this requirement prior to making an application. For more information, please visit our International Students page.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About SimScale

SimScale is the world's first cloud-based, AI-native engineering simulation platform. CFD, FEA, thermal and electromagnetics run together in a single browser-based environment, supported by Engineering AI that guides simulation setup, Physics AI that returns validated predictions in seconds, and agentic workflows that execute multi-step simulation pipelines at any scale.

The conviction behind the platform is straightforward: every engineer should be free to explore thousands of design options, test them instantly and decide with confidence, not only the specialists who have traditionally held the CAE tools. Founded in Munich in 2012 by five engineers, SimScale is trusted today by more than 800,000 engineers worldwide, at companies including Johnson & Johnson, Mitsubishi, Magna, Toshiba, Bühler, AECOM and Zaha Hadid Architects.

The role

As an Enterprise CSM
you are the partnership lead on a short selection of SimScale's top-tier enterprise accounts. Your work is to turn a foothold into an enterprise standard: drive adoption, prove the value delivered, build the relationships that give you real influence, and open the parts of the organisation that have not yet engaged. Your measure is the Net Retention Rate
across your accounts.

Why this role matters

The contribution of this role is crucial to SimScale's success. Our top-tier accounts hold significant room to grow, and this role creates the conditions for that growth (through adoption, through evidenced value, and through the relationships that open new parts of a large organisation).

This is also a role with room to shape things. Alongside your accounts, you will have the opportunity to help shape and continuously optimise how Customer Success works at SimScale: how we run enterprise partnerships, what a great executive business review looks like, and how value realization is evidenced, in an international environment with a great deal of opportunity in it.

What you will own

The partnership and growth agenda
for a short selection of our top-tier enterprise accounts, with the time to go deep in each one.

Relationships with the people who decide.
Key decision makers, executive sponsors, and the Initiative Business Owners
who hold the budget and the outcomes for the programmes SimScale supports. Real influence with them is the foundation of everything else in this role.

Adoption initiatives
that make SimScale the default simulation platform across engineering teams: enablement, standardisation, and embedding it in how engineers work day to day.

Enterprise programme management
: multi-team, multi-site rollouts run to a plan, with milestones and executive reporting.

Value realization, then leverage.
Define success metrics with the customer, evidence the ROI, and use the value generated in one team as the business case to scale the account
into the next department, site or entity. Value realization is the engine of growth in this role.

Mapping and opening the enterprise
: discovering departments, entities, business units and sites not yet engaged, identifying the right people inside them, and creating the conditions for growth.

Operational and executive business reviews
that shape the customer's simulation strategy.

Orchestration of a full internal team around your accounts
: Marketing (ABM campaigns), SDR, Solution Engineering and your commercial colleagues. You set the account's direction and mobilise the people who help deliver it.

Net Retention Rate across your accounts
, including identifying risk early and bringing the right colleagues onto it.

Who you will work with

SimScale is a collaborative environment, and this role sits right in the middle of it. You will have a full internal team around each of your accounts:

Marketing
designs and runs ABM campaigns into your accounts with you, turning your account intelligence into targeted programmes.

SDR
takes the leads and new-department contacts you identify and runs structured outreach on them.

Solution Engineering
brings the technical proof, pilots and enablement that make adoption real.

Your commercial colleagues
take the qualified opportunities you create through negotiation and signature, so you can stay focused on the partnership.

Product and Engineering
take the Voice of Customer from our largest accounts into the roadmap.

What we expect from you

7+ years in a senior, customer-facing role on large enterprise accounts
in SaaS or technical software (CAE, PLM, CAD, EDA, simulation or comparable).

A track record of growing enterprise accounts through adoption, programme execution and internal expansion
: you have opened new departments and business units inside an existing customer, whether or not you held the pen on the contract.

Executive relationship-building.
You can earn and keep the confidence of VP-level decision makers and business owners, and be treated as an advisor.

Programme-management strength
across multi-stakeholder, multi-site enterprise rollouts.

Value-realization method.
You have defined success criteria with a customer and evidenced the value delivered.

Experience in an engineering domain:
enough grounding in engineering, simulation or comparable technical products to be credible with Heads of Engineering, VP R&D and Chief Engineers, and to discuss their challenges in their own terms. Hands-on practitioner depth is not required.

Comfort as the orchestrator of a virtual account team
, driving outcomes together with colleagues across Marketing, SDR, Solution Engineering and Sales.

AI-native ways of working.
You already use AI daily for productivity, and you can hold a credible conversation about what Engineering AI and Physics AI mean for an engineering organisation.

Location:
EMEA (CET / GMT), fully remote, 10–15% travel.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SimScale:
At SimScale, we look beyond borders and hire great talent from all parts of the world. With our team consisting of people from various backgrounds, we truly embrace diversity and encourage everyone to be themselves. We are unified by curiosity, dedication and our team spirit! As an equal opportunity employer, we acknowledge that our employees have different aspirations and career goals, and therefore are committed to create a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. A copy of SimScale's full recruiting guideline can be made available on request. Kindly let us know how you would like to be addressed and whether you have specific requirements for the interview.

jobs.title: (Senior) Commercial Customer Success Manager (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment-Tech

Willkommen bei vivenu – dem globalen Vorreiter für Event-Ticketing-Technologie und einem der weltweit schnellst wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen im Live-Entertainment. Wir revolutionieren Ticketing für internationale Größen wie die Grammys, die Golden Globes, die Stanford University und den Hockenheimring – und machen aus einer einfachen Ticketing-Transaktion einen echten strategischen Wettbewerbsvorteil. Mit über 65 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung im Rücken ermöglicht unsere Plattform Veranstaltern, ihre Markenpräsenz selbst zu steuern, tiefgreifende Datenanalysen zu nutzen und Ticketing nahtlos in ihre digitale Infrastruktur zu integrieren.

Mit sechs Standorten weltweit bieten wir eine intuitive, individuell anpassbare Lösung und branchenführenden Support, der selbst die komplexesten Herausforderungen im Ticketing vereinfacht. So helfen wir Veranstaltern, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu erzielen.

Werde Teil unserer Mission – und gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment mit.

Als (Senior) Commercial Customer Success Manager (d/f/m) übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

High-Level Customer Success:
Verantworte ein Portfolio unserer größten und anspruchsvollsten Enterprise-Kunden in Deutschland. Entwickle maßgeschneiderte Erfolgsstrategien, die komplexe Kundenanforderungen lösen und nachhaltig auf die langfristigen Ziele unserer Partner einzahlen.
Onboarding & Projektmanagement:
Steuere das Kunden-Onboarding sowie die technische Projektabwicklung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern. Stelle eine pünktliche, skalierbare und qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung sicher.
Strategisches Stakeholder-Management:
Baue belastbare Beziehungen auf allen Kundenebenen auf – von operativen Event- und Box-Office-Teams bis hin zur C-Level-Ebene. Fördere das Engagement durch regelmäßige Business Reviews, Strategie-Workshops und vivenu Labs.
Beratung zu Wachstum & Transformation:
Identifiziere und erschließe Umsatzpotenziale durch strategische Beratung zur Optimierung von Event-Setups, Pricing-Strategien und dem digitalen Kundenerlebnis.
Kundenzentrierte Transformation:
Berate Kunden aktiv dabei, komplexe Ticketing- und Governance-Prozesse zu digitalisieren und neue, datengetriebene Geschäftsmodelle über die vivenu-Plattform umzusetzen.
Performance-Analyse & Health Monitoring:
Analysiere relevante KPIs und Nutzungsmuster kontinuierlich, um Churn-Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Steigerung der Feature-Adoption und Kundenzufriedenheit einzuleiten.
Strategisches Verlängerungsmanagement (Renewal Management):
Treibe Vertragsverlängerungen und Account-Expansions voran, indem du den klaren ROI aufzeigst, Produkt-Roadmaps abstimmst und langfristiges Vertrauen schaffst.
Stimme des Enterprise-Kunden:
Vertrete die Anforderungen unserer Großkunden intern durch strukturiertes Feedback an unsere Produkt- und Engineering-Teams im Headquarter, um die zukünftige Plattformentwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten.
Enablement & Fortgeschrittenes Produkttraining:
Befähige unsere Kunden durch gezielte Schulungen und Release-Briefings, das volle Potenzial fortgeschrittener sowie neuer Plattform-Features (z. B. AI-Agent, Marketing-Tools) vollumfänglich zu nutzen.

Das brauchst du, um in der Rolle erfolgreich zu sein:

Enterprise-Beziehungsmanagement:
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit verschiedenen Kunden auf mehreren Ebenen, einschließlich C-Level, operativen und technischen Stakeholdern.
Ticketing Operations / Branchenexpertise:
Praktische Erfahrung im operativen Ticketing oder Arbeit bei einem Ticketing-Unternehmen (z. B. Ticketing-Plattformen, Veranstaltungsorte, Sportteams, Promoter oder Unterhaltungsorganisationen). Starkes Verständnis von Event-Abläufen, Box-Office-Workflows und dem gesamten Ticketing-Lebenszyklus.
Strategisches Portfolio- & Projektmanagement:
Bewiesene Fähigkeit, ein strategisches Kundenportfolio zu managen und komplexe Onboardings, Plattform-Migrationen und Integrationen mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu liefern.
Technisches Verständnis:
Vertrautheit mit APIs, Integrationen, Zugriffskontrollen und Enterprise-Plattformfunktionen, mit der Fähigkeit, technische Konzepte in operativen und geschäftlichen Mehrwert zu übersetzen.
Strategische Erfolgsplanung:
Erfahrung in der Erstellung umsetzbarer Erfolgspläne unter Nutzung von Customer Discovery, CRM-Erkenntnissen, operativen Daten und relevanten Branchentrends.
Starke Kommunikations- & Beratungskompetenz:
Fähigkeit, komplexe Konzepte klar zu kommunizieren und Kunden beratend zur Seite zu stehen – von technischen Workshops bis hin zu Meetings auf Führungsebene.
Proaktive Problemlösung:
Eine lösungsorientierte Denkweise, insbesondere beim Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Kundenszenarien, operativen Herausforderungen oder Plattformthemen.
Customer Success Expertise:
Erfahrung in der Anwendung von CS-Frameworks wie Stakeholder-Mapping, Health Monitoring und Executive Business Reviews, um die Akzeptanz und Expansion innerhalb von Enterprise-Accounts voranzutreiben.
Erfahrung:
Mindestens 4 Jahre im Customer Success, Account Management oder in Ticketing Operations innerhalb der Ticketing- oder der breiteren Live-Event-Branche.

About SimScale

SimScale is the world's first cloud-based, AI-native engineering simulation platform. CFD, FEA, thermal and electromagnetics run together in a single browser-based environment, supported by Engineering AI that guides simulation setup, Physics AI that returns validated predictions in seconds, and agentic workflows that execute multi-step simulation pipelines at any scale.

The conviction behind the platform is straightforward: every engineer should be free to explore thousands of design options, test them instantly and decide with confidence, not only the specialists who have traditionally held the CAE tools. Founded in Munich in 2012 by five engineers, SimScale is trusted today by more than 800,000 engineers worldwide, at companies including Johnson & Johnson, Mitsubishi, Magna, Toshiba, Bühler, AECOM and Zaha Hadid Architects.

The role

As a Customer Success Manager
you own the lifetime value of a book of SimScale accounts: Commercial and High Potential customers, including some enterprise-sized names, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You carry a renewal and expansion number, and you own it through to signature.

Why this role matters

The contribution of this role is crucial to SimScale's success. Every renewal protected and every expansion landed shows up directly in the company's growth, and the relationships you build determine how deeply simulation takes hold inside each customer's engineering organisation.

This is also a role with room to shape things. Alongside owning your book, you will have the opportunity to help shape and continuously optimise how Customer Success works at SimScale: the customer journey, the playbooks, the segmentation and the tooling, in an international environment with a great deal of opportunity in it.

What you will own

Your book, end-to-end.
A portfolio of Commercial and High Potential accounts through the full journey: onboarding, adoption, mid-term engagement, Business Reviews, renewal and expansion.

A commercial number you own through to signature.
Build and manage your renewal and expansion pipeline, run opportunity management through the pipeline
, negotiate contract adjustments and pricing, and close.

Account growth plan strategy.
For every account that matters, define where the value sits today, where the next team, site or use case is, and what needs to happen to get there.

Expansion campaigns on your key accounts

Programme management of the work that unlocks growth

Customer health.

You can build, forecast and work a pipeline in a CRM, and your forecast is one people rely on.

Negotiation and closing experience.
You have handled commercial terms, contract adjustments, pricing conversations and procurement, and you are comfortable asking for the order.

Customer cohort management.
You have run a substantial book of accounts, and you can tier it, prioritise it and cover it well.

You can drive a pilot, benchmark or rollout to a timeline across teams that do not report to you.

A proven track record of sales and of growing customer accounts

CRM discipline (Salesforce or HubSpot).

Experience running a tiered / segmented touch model

Experience cross-selling an AI layer onto a core subscription, or running retention and expansion campaigns together with a marketing team.

jobs.title: Customer Success Executive
jobs.description:
Role Mission

You own the health system relationship after go-live — and you own what happens to it next. Your mandate is retention, measurable clinical and operational outcomes, and expansion from a first live use case into a platform footprint across the system.

This is not a deployment role. Our Implementation Managers own configuration, data onboarding, and the run to go-live. You take the account from there and answer a different question: is this health system getting the outcomes it bought, does its executive team know it, and what is the next use case?

This role exists because the hardest part of selling AI into health systems is not the first launch — it is the second one. Systems that see real results in post-discharge follow-up should be running care gap closure, chronic disease management, and preventive outreach within a year. Someone has to prove the first program worked, keep the sponsor coalition intact through leadership turnover, and make the case for the next program in the language of the CNO, CFO, and CMO.

What You Will Accomplish

By day 90:
you will have taken over a portfolio of live health system accounts, built an outcomes baseline for each, and delivered your first executive business review presenting measured program performance against the metrics the customer bought. You will have mapped the full stakeholder landscape in each account and identified at least one qualified expansion opportunity per account.

At 12 months:
you will have delivered gross retention on your book, sourced and influenced expansion into new use cases across multiple health systems, established the outcomes reporting model HAI uses with all provider customers, and converted at least one customer into a public reference.

The Team

You'll report into Customer Success leadership and work alongside Implementation, Clinical, Product, Engineering, and Sales. You'll partner with health system CNOs, CMOs, VPs of Care Management and Population Health, service line leaders, quality teams, and nursing operations. This role requires equal parts executive presence and operational credibility with the floor.

What You'll Do

Own retention and growth on a named book of health system accounts — carry gross and net retention targets, own the renewal narrative, and source and influence expansion into new use cases and service lines
Build and defend the outcomes case — define, instrument, and report the metrics each health system bought (readmission reduction, care gap closure, contact and completion rates, nursing time returned to the bedside, cost per completed outreach) and translate them into an executive-ready business case
Run quarterly and annual executive business reviews with clinical, operational, and financial leadership — performance, peer benchmarking, and the agenda for next quarter
Drive adoption and durable workflow change across nursing and clinical operations after go-live, preventing the adoption decay that quietly kills renewals
Identify, qualify, and shape expansion opportunities — surface the next use case, build the business case with the customer, and partner with Sales to close; you source and shape, Sales signs
Maintain account health scoring and risk forecasting — give leadership an honest, early, specific read on which accounts are at risk and why

Location Requirements

This is a field-facing role. Health systems expect presence, and our best customer relationships are built onsite. Expect 25–40% travel, including regular multi-day visits for executive reviews, adoption work, and clinical rounding, with overnight and out-of-state trips. Periodic travel to our Menlo Park headquarters is expected.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 5 years in customer success, account management, client partnership, or strategic accounts — with at least 4 years serving health systems, hospitals, health networks, or provider organizations
Demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes on a named book — retention, renewal, or expansion targets you were personally measured against, with specific results
Executive presence with health system leadership — a track record of running business reviews with C-suite and VP-level clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders
Fluency in health system operations and clinical workflow — how care teams work, how quality is measured, and how capital and operating decisions get made

About SimScale

SimScale is the world's first cloud-based, AI-native engineering simulation platform. CFD, FEA, thermal and electromagnetics run together in a single browser-based environment, supported by Engineering AI that guides simulation setup, Physics AI that returns validated predictions in seconds, and agentic workflows that execute multi-step simulation pipelines at any scale.

The conviction behind the platform is straightforward: every engineer should be free to explore thousands of design options, test them instantly and decide with confidence, not only the specialists who have traditionally held the CAE tools. Founded in Munich in 2012 by five engineers, SimScale is trusted today by more than 800,000 engineers worldwide, at companies including Johnson & Johnson, Mitsubishi, Magna, Toshiba, Bühler, AECOM and Zaha Hadid Architects.

The role

As an Enterprise CSM
you are the partnership lead on a short selection of SimScale's top-tier enterprise accounts. Your work is to turn a foothold into an enterprise standard: drive adoption, prove the value delivered, build the relationships that give you real influence, and open the parts of the organisation that have not yet engaged. Your measure is the Net Retention Rate
across your accounts.

Why this role matters

The contribution of this role is crucial to SimScale's success. Our top-tier accounts hold significant room to grow, and this role creates the conditions for that growth (through adoption, through evidenced value, and through the relationships that open new parts of a large organisation).

This is also a role with room to shape things. Alongside your accounts, you will have the opportunity to help shape and continuously optimise how Customer Success works at SimScale: how we run enterprise partnerships, what a great executive business review looks like, and how value realization is evidenced, in an international environment with a great deal of opportunity in it.

What you will own

The partnership and growth agenda
for a short selection of our top-tier enterprise accounts, with the time to go deep in each one.

Relationships with the people who decide.
Key decision makers, executive sponsors, and the Initiative Business Owners
who hold the budget and the outcomes for the programmes SimScale supports. Real influence with them is the foundation of everything else in this role.

Adoption initiatives
that make SimScale the default simulation platform across engineering teams: enablement, standardisation, and embedding it in how engineers work day to day.

Enterprise programme management
: multi-team, multi-site rollouts run to a plan, with milestones and executive reporting.

Value realization, then leverage.
Define success metrics with the customer, evidence the ROI, and use the value generated in one team as the business case to scale the account
into the next department, site or entity. Value realization is the engine of growth in this role.

Mapping and opening the enterprise
: discovering departments, entities, business units and sites not yet engaged, identifying the right people inside them, and creating the conditions for growth.

Operational and executive business reviews
that shape the customer's simulation strategy.

Orchestration of a full internal team around your accounts
: Marketing (ABM campaigns), SDR, Solution Engineering and your commercial colleagues. You set the account's direction and mobilise the people who help deliver it.

Net Retention Rate across your accounts
, including identifying risk early and bringing the right colleagues onto it.

Who you will work with

SimScale is a collaborative environment, and this role sits right in the middle of it. You will have a full internal team around each of your accounts:

Marketing
designs and runs ABM campaigns into your accounts with you, turning your account intelligence into targeted programmes.

SDR
takes the leads and new-department contacts you identify and runs structured outreach on them.

Solution Engineering
brings the technical proof, pilots and enablement that make adoption real.

Your commercial colleagues
take the qualified opportunities you create through negotiation and signature, so you can stay focused on the partnership.

Product and Engineering
take the Voice of Customer from our largest accounts into the roadmap.

What we expect from you

7+ years in a senior, customer-facing role on large enterprise accounts
in SaaS or technical software (CAE, PLM, CAD, EDA, simulation or comparable).

A track record of growing enterprise accounts through adoption, programme execution and internal expansion
: you have opened new departments and business units inside an existing customer, whether or not you held the pen on the contract.

Executive relationship-building.
You can earn and keep the confidence of VP-level decision makers and business owners, and be treated as an advisor.

Programme-management strength
across multi-stakeholder, multi-site enterprise rollouts.

Value-realization method.
You have defined success criteria with a customer and evidenced the value delivered.

Experience in an engineering domain:
enough grounding in engineering, simulation or comparable technical products to be credible with Heads of Engineering, VP R&D and Chief Engineers, and to discuss their challenges in their own terms. Hands-on practitioner depth is not required.

Comfort as the orchestrator of a virtual account team
, driving outcomes together with colleagues across Marketing, SDR, Solution Engineering and Sales.

AI-native ways of working.
You already use AI daily for productivity, and you can hold a credible conversation about what Engineering AI and Physics AI mean for an engineering organisation.

Location:
EMEA (CET / GMT), fully remote, 10–15% travel.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SimScale:
At SimScale, we look beyond borders and hire great talent from all parts of the world. With our team consisting of people from various backgrounds, we truly embrace diversity and encourage everyone to be themselves. We are unified by curiosity, dedication and our team spirit! About SimScale

SimScale is the world's first cloud-based, AI-native engineering simulation platform. CFD, FEA, thermal and electromagnetics run together in a single browser-based environment, supported by Engineering AI that guides simulation setup, Physics AI that returns validated predictions in seconds, and agentic workflows that execute multi-step simulation pipelines at any scale.

The conviction behind the platform is straightforward: every engineer should be free to explore thousands of design options, test them instantly and decide with confidence, not only the specialists who have traditionally held the CAE tools. Founded in Munich in 2012 by five engineers, SimScale is trusted today by more than 800,000 engineers worldwide, at companies including Johnson & Johnson, Mitsubishi, Magna, Toshiba, Bühler, AECOM and Zaha Hadid Architects.

The role

As a Customer Success Manager
you own the lifetime value of a book of SimScale accounts: Commercial and High Potential customers, including some enterprise-sized names, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You carry a renewal and expansion number, and you own it through to signature.

Why this role matters

The contribution of this role is crucial to SimScale's success. Every renewal protected and every expansion landed shows up directly in the company's growth, and the relationships you build determine how deeply simulation takes hold inside each customer's engineering organisation.

This is also a role with room to shape things. Alongside owning your book, you will have the opportunity to help shape and continuously optimise how Customer Success works at SimScale: the customer journey, the playbooks, the segmentation and the tooling, in an international environment with a great deal of opportunity in it.

What you will own

Your book, end-to-end.
A portfolio of Commercial and High Potential accounts through the full journey: onboarding, adoption, mid-term engagement, Business Reviews, renewal and expansion.

A commercial number you own through to signature.
Build and manage your renewal and expansion pipeline, run opportunity management through the pipeline
, negotiate contract adjustments and pricing, and close.

Account growth plan strategy.
For every account that matters, define where the value sits today, where the next team, site or use case is, and what needs to happen to get there.

Expansion campaigns on your key accounts
, targeted, multi-touch plays into specific engineering teams and use cases, designed together with Marketing and run to a plan.

Programme management of the work that unlocks growth
: benchmarks, pilots and technical evaluations, coordinated across the customer's engineers and ours, to a clear timeline.

Organic and referral-led growth.
Champion networks, internal referrals, and the word-of-mouth that travels between engineering teams inside a large company.

Business Reviews customers value attending
, anchored on ROI and realised value.

Customer health.
Identify retention risk early, define the mitigation plan and execute it, and decide which pivotal accounts
to concentrate on for retention or expansion.

A segmented delivery model.
Tech-touch and agentic CS motions so every account in the long tail gets a genuinely good experience at scale; high-touch attention where ARR level and growth potential justify it.

Adoption of Engineering AI / Physics AI
across your book, the newest and most strategic part of our platform.

Who you will work with

SimScale is a collaborative environment, and this role sits right in the middle of it. You will have colleagues around you whose work is closely tied to your success:

Marketing
partners with you on expansion campaigns, lifecycle and nurture programmes and content, extending your reach across every user in your book. You bring the account insight; they bring the campaign machinery.

Support
shares a live view of account health with you, so signals from the customer reach you early and you can act on them together.

Application Engineering and Solution Engineering
bring the technical depth behind benchmarks, pilots and evaluations, so customers see results quickly.

Product and Engineering
take your Voice of Customer input into the roadmap, and give you the context to speak credibly about what is coming.

Sales
hands over new customers with full context, and partners with you on the largest opportunities.

What we expect from you

4+ years customer-facing in high-growth SaaS, carrying a number.
We are deliberately open on job title: Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, Account Executive, Sales Representative
, Client Partner, Technical Account Manager. What matters is that you have personally owned renewals and/or expansion and closed them
.

Pipeline and opportunity management.
You can build, forecast and work a pipeline in a CRM, and your forecast is one people rely on.

Negotiation and closing experience.
You have handled commercial terms, contract adjustments, pricing conversations and procurement, and you are comfortable asking for the order.

Customer cohort management.
You have run a substantial book of accounts, and you can tier it, prioritise it and cover it well.

Project and programme management.
You can drive a pilot, benchmark or rollout to a timeline across teams that do not report to you.

A proven track record of sales and of growing customer accounts
: expansion you can point to and explain how you created.

Credible engineering / CAE domain footing
, enough to hold a real conversation with a simulation engineer and with their VP.

AI-native ways of working.
You already use AI daily for productivity (call preparation, summarisation, research, CRM insight) and you are keen to push further. It is how the team works.

CRM discipline (Salesforce or HubSpot).

Nice to have

Experience running a tiered / segmented touch model
, including automation and AI-assisted or agentic CS workflows.

A hands-on CFD / FEA / thermal background.

Experience cross-selling an AI layer onto a core subscription, or running retention and expansion campaigns together with a marketing team.

Location:
US (EST / CST).

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SimScale:
At SimScale, we look beyond borders and hire great talent from all parts of the world. With our team consisting of people from various backgrounds, we truly embrace diversity and encourage everyone to be themselves. We are unified by curiosity, dedication and our team spirit! As an equal opportunity employer, we acknowledge that our employees have different aspirations and career goals, and therefore are committed to create a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. A copy of SimScale's full recruiting guideline can be made available on request. Kindly let us know how you would like to be addressed and whether you have specific requirements for the interview.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Executive
new_jobs.description:
Role Mission

You own the health system relationship after go-live — and you own what happens to it next. Your mandate is retention, measurable clinical and operational outcomes, and expansion from a first live use case into a platform footprint across the system.

This is not a deployment role. Our Implementation Managers own configuration, data onboarding, and the run to go-live. You take the account from there and answer a different question: is this health system getting the outcomes it bought, does its executive team know it, and what is the next use case?

This role exists because the hardest part of selling AI into health systems is not the first launch — it is the second one. Systems that see real results in post-discharge follow-up should be running care gap closure, chronic disease management, and preventive outreach within a year. Someone has to prove the first program worked, keep the sponsor coalition intact through leadership turnover, and make the case for the next program in the language of the CNO, CFO, and CMO.

What You Will Accomplish

By day 90:
you will have taken over a portfolio of live health system accounts, built an outcomes baseline for each, and delivered your first executive business review presenting measured program performance against the metrics the customer bought. You will have mapped the full stakeholder landscape in each account and identified at least one qualified expansion opportunity per account.

At 12 months:
you will have delivered gross retention on your book, sourced and influenced expansion into new use cases across multiple health systems, established the outcomes reporting model HAI uses with all provider customers, and converted at least one customer into a public reference.

The Team

You'll report into Customer Success leadership and work alongside Implementation, Clinical, Product, Engineering, and Sales. You'll partner with health system CNOs, CMOs, VPs of Care Management and Population Health, service line leaders, quality teams, and nursing operations. This role requires equal parts executive presence and operational credibility with the floor.

What You'll Do

Own retention and growth on a named book of health system accounts — carry gross and net retention targets, own the renewal narrative, and source and influence expansion into new use cases and service lines
Build and defend the outcomes case — define, instrument, and report the metrics each health system bought (readmission reduction, care gap closure, contact and completion rates, nursing time returned to the bedside, cost per completed outreach) and translate them into an executive-ready business case
Run quarterly and annual executive business reviews with clinical, operational, and financial leadership — performance, peer benchmarking, and the agenda for next quarter
Drive adoption and durable workflow change across nursing and clinical operations after go-live, preventing the adoption decay that quietly kills renewals
Identify, qualify, and shape expansion opportunities — surface the next use case, build the business case with the customer, and partner with Sales to close; you source and shape, Sales signs
Maintain account health scoring and risk forecasting — give leadership an honest, early, specific read on which accounts are at risk and why

Location Requirements

This is a field-facing role. Health systems expect presence, and our best customer relationships are built onsite. Expect 25–40% travel, including regular multi-day visits for executive reviews, adoption work, and clinical rounding, with overnight and out-of-state trips. Periodic travel to our Menlo Park headquarters is expected.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 5 years in customer success, account management, client partnership, or strategic accounts — with at least 4 years serving health systems, hospitals, health networks, or provider organizations
Demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes on a named book — retention, renewal, or expansion targets you were personally measured against, with specific results
Executive presence with health system leadership — a track record of running business reviews with C-suite and VP-level clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders
Fluency in health system operations and clinical workflow — how care teams work, how quality is measured, and how capital and operating decisions get made
Proven ability to build a quantified outcomes case and present ROI to a skeptical financial audience
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

Preferred Qualifications

Background at a healthcare SaaS or health AI company serving providers, in a role where implementation was a separate function
Health system operator experience — nursing leadership, care management, population health, quality, or service line administration
Clinical license (RN, LPN, or similar) or prior clinical practice
Healthcare consulting or transformation experience with provider clients
Familiarity with EHR ecosystems (Epic, Cerner, Athena) and how they shape what is operationally possible
Experience with patient engagement, virtual care, or care management platforms
Track record of converting customers into references, case studies, or conference co-presentations
Experience in a role where CS carried a quota or formal revenue responsibility

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.
We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future.
Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.
We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.
Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @
hippocraticai.com
email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

Welcome to vivenu, the global leader in event ticketing tech and one of the world’s fastest-growing live entertainment tech firms. Backed by over $65 million in funding, our platform empowers event organizers to own their brand experience, unlock deep data insights, and seamlessly integrate ticketing into their digital infrastructure.

With six offices worldwide and growing, we deliver a customizable, intuitive solution and industry-leading support that simplify even the most complex ticketing challenges – helping organizers deliver exceptional experiences and drive real growth.

Join us and build the future of live entertainment.
As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager your responsibilities will include:

Enterprise-Level Customer Success:
Own a strategic portfolio of our most important and technically complex customers. Develop tailored success strategies aligned with long-term customer goals.
Enterprise Onboarding & Project Management:
Lead technical onboarding and project delivery in close collaboration with internal teams and customer stakeholders – ensuring timely, scalable, and high-quality execution.
Strategic Stakeholder Management:
Build deep relationships across all customer levels – from operational teams to executives – and drive engagement through business reviews, strategy workshops, and vivenu Labs.
Growth & Transformation Advisory:
Identify and unlock revenue potential through strategic consulting on event, pricing, or digital experience optimization.
Customer-Centric Transformation:
Enable customers to digitize complex processes and drive new business models using the vivenu platform.
Health Monitoring & Performance Analysis:
Analyze KPIs and usage patterns to detect risks early and recommend concrete actions for increased adoption and satisfaction.
Strategic Renewal Management:
Drive contract renewals and expansions by showcasing value, aligning roadmaps, and building long-term trust.
Voice of the Enterprise Customer:
Represent the enterprise customer perspective internally – providing structured feedback to product and engineering teams to shape future development.
Enablement & Advanced Product Training:
Ensure that customer teams are up to date and fully enabled to use advanced platform features through training sessions and release briefings.

What you will need to succeed in this role:

Enterprise Relationship Management:
Demonstrated experience working with large-scale, enterprise clients across multiple levels, including C-level, operations, and technical stakeholders.
Ticketing Operations / Industry Expertise:
Hands-on experience in ticketing operations or working at a ticketing company (e.g., ticketing platforms, venues, sports teams, promoters, or entertainment organizations). Strong understanding of event operations, box office workflows, and the end-to-end ticketing lifecycle.
Strategic Portfolio & Project Management:
Proven ability to manage a strategic customer portfolio and deliver complex onboarding, platform migrations, and integrations with cross-functional teams.
Technical Acumen:
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, access controls, and enterprise-grade platform features, with the ability to translate technical concepts into operational and business value.
Strategic Success Planning:
Experience creating actionable success plans using customer discovery, CRM insights, operational data, and relevant industry trends.
Strong Communication & Consulting Skills:
Ability to clearly communicate complex concepts and provide consultative guidance to customers – from technical workshops to executive-level meetings.
Proactive Problem Solving:
A solution-oriented mindset, particularly when navigating sophisticated customer scenarios, operational challenges, or platform issues.
Customer Success Expertise:
Experience using CS frameworks such as stakeholder mapping, health monitoring, and executive business reviews to drive adoption and expansion within enterprise accounts.
Experience:
Minimum 5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Ticketing Operations within the ticketing or broader live events industry.

$150,000 - $200,000 a year

This base salary range may include several career levels at vivenu and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Additional benefits for this role may include a performance bonus.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description
Scint.ai is an AI-powered platform helping manufacturers simplify complex workflows across quoting, sourcing, costing, and production. The platform brings together information from BOMs, drawings, spreadsheets, supplier quotes, and enterprise systems to automate repetitive work and help teams make faster, better-informed decisions. From RFQ and supplier management to labor estimation, pricing, work instructions, and custom workflows, Scint.ai is built to adapt to how manufacturers actually operate and integrate with the systems they already use.

Role Description
The Customer Success Manager is a contract role with regular travel to customer sites. You will be responsible for building strong relationships with Scint.ai customers and helping them get the most value from the platform. You will work directly with customers to understand their workflows, challenges, and requirements, help configure and implement Scint.ai within their operations, and serve as the primary bridge between customers and our product and engineering team. Day-to-day responsibilities include onboarding and training users, visiting customer sites to understand their operations firsthand, hosting regular customer meetings, helping customers use and configure the platform, troubleshooting issues, gathering and translating feedback into clear product requirements, and coordinating with the technical team on new features and customer-specific solutions. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working closely with customers, understanding how businesses operate, and turning real-world needs into practical software solutions.

Qualifications

Strong customer-facing skills with the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with customers and understand their operational needs.
Experience working with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or other technical products; experience in manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, or operations is a strong plus.
Comfortable visiting customer sites, learning how their teams work firsthand, and translating real-world workflows and challenges into clear product requirements.
Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly understand software workflows, integrations, data structures, and new product features.
Ability to communicate effectively between customers and product and engineering teams, including clearly documenting requirements, issues, and feature requests.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to train users and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on approach to troubleshooting customer issues and finding practical solutions.
Highly organized and able to manage multiple customer relationships, implementations, and priorities simultaneously.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly to customer locations.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
